Dynasty Warriors

Basic Commands Base Characters Zhao Yun Guan Yu Zhang Fei Xiahou Dun Dian Wei Xu Zhu Zhou Yu Lu Xun Taishi Ci Diao Chan Unlockable characters Zhuge Liang Cao Cao Lu Bu Code characters Sun Shang Xiang Nobunaga Toukichi

The Dynasty Warriors series originally started as a fighting game which the rest of the series did not follow through with, this guide is meant to help with the move list of each playable character so you know what button combinations to press to get your desired attacks. This guide is meant for the US version, but note that if you are playing on the Japanese version C & D have their commands swapped, this is included for codes.

Basic Commands

Command Description
A A horizontal swipe.
B A vertical attack or a thrust.
C Defends against A swipes.
D Defends against B swipes.
C+D Side step.
A+B Will do a throw from the front only.
&/@@*@@/(+A/B A lunging attack that can also be used to pursuit a downed enemy.
+A+C or +B+D On the bottom of the screen a bar will fill up, when it is full you are able to perform your characters musou attack. If your health is Red and the bar is full it will be a longer combo.

These characters have an ending which you get by going through the 1P Battle mode.

BB, @+AAB High thrust followed a mid thrust followed by low spinning swing followed a downward swing ending with a pushing thrust.
@@^^@@+AA Inward mid swing followed by an outward pushing mid swing.
@@^^@@+ABB Inward mid swing followed by a poke with the butt end of the Spear ending with a mid pushing thrust.
@@^^@@+AB,+B Inward mid swing followed by a poke with the butt end of the Spear ending with a three quick mid thrusts.
@@^^@@+BB Mid poke with the butt end of the Spear ending with a mid pushing thrust.
@@^^@@+B,+B Mid poke with the butt end of the Spear ending with a three quick mid thrusts.
While Standing A Lifting upward swing.

1+AAB Low swing followed by a pushing downward chop ending with a mid poke.
3+BAAB Mid thrust followed by low spinning swing followed a downward swing ending with a pushing thrust.
+AA Tripping low inward swing followed by a lifting upward swing.

+AAAAB 5 Spinning upward swings ending with a pushing thrust. Used for his Musou Attack in Dynasty Warriors 2 through 5.
+B+D,+B True Musou extension after the poke with the butt end of the Spear, does three quick mid thrusts.

Code characters

These are characters that you have to enter a code to unlock, these characters do not have an ending if you use them in 1P Battle. If Selection type is set to Normal Type they are located off screen, if Selection type is set to Quick Type press [ or ] and hover over a specific character who's moveset they are a copy of.

Sun Shang Xiang

On the title screen press $$*@BA[] you will hear a chime to telling you that the code was entered correctly. To play as her press [ or ] and hover over Zhou Yu.

Nobunaga

After clearing 1P Battle with Lu Bu on the title screen press A@@*@@B@C you will hear a chime to telling you that the code was entered correctly. To play as him press [ or ] and hover over Lu Bu.

Toukichi

After clearing 1P Battle with Nobunaga on the title screen press @@^@@*@@DB]} you will hear a chime to telling you that the code was entered correctly. To play as him press [ or ] and hover over Cao Cao.
